notes.title: Castle Ruins is now available!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, adventurers![/p][p][/p][p]With this update, you can now enter the Castle Ruins portal and fight new enemies and perhaps find Uncommon quality weapons. Here's a list of what has been changed:

1. New NPCs in Merchants Path map for world building[/p][p]2. Castle Ruins portal is open - but only floors 1 to 5[/p][p]3. Slight change to the UDS (Ultra Dynamic Sky) in Merchants Path[/p][p]4. Some enemies can drop "Bronze Keys" to unlock chests within the Castle Ruins[/p][p]5. Castle Ruins has more than 40 room types to explore![/p][p][/p][p]The next update will focus on the CR floors 6 and beyond, but probably won't drop until the end of this month. There's a LOT of ground to cover for those floors and that's not including the enemies that I will have to tweak as well.[/p][p][/p][p]Anyways, hope ya'll enjoy this update and be sure to drop some feedback on either here or Discord :)[/p]

notes.title: Update Delayed
notes.notes: [p]Not that I wanted this to happen but it is rather unavoidable, and that is the delay for this update that was supposed to be released tomorrow (08/31). The rooms do "stitch" together perfectly and there are plenty of enemies to fight - but that only applies for Floors 1-5 and not 6-10 as I had promised. There are new types of rooms being introduced there and require a tad bit more time to fix.[/p][p][/p][p]Not only that, but I also need to fix the side-stepping anims for the playable characters. It started off not really bothering me until it did. That, and fixing some foliage in the overworld, as well...[/p][p][/p][p]So yea, the update should be ready by 09/02/2025 :D[/p]

notes.title: Update: World Building and more
notes.notes:
Hello hello!

Within this update, the following changes are:

1. Mountain Trolls now roam the outer areas of Merchants Path, and they are all at level 20.

2. Gazers (level 1 enemy) now also roam Merchants Path.

3. New NPCs added to Merchants Path.

4. New ruins added to Merchants Path (and more will be added in the next update).

5. Kinda "fixed" the cooldown for basic attack for each character (although it still needs work).

6. Removed enemy count within Harver Stronghold and Galgin Mines so that it doesn't appear overwhelming.

7. Minor misc tweaking done to the UI.

The next update will most likely be ready two weeks from now, but will keep ya'll posted should anything change. What I will be aiming for is the return of the randomized dungeons but that will take more time to implement, so instead, there will more fixes to the cooldowns and character skill trees.

Again, let me know either on here or [url=https://discord.gg/YH5WNS6DPe]Discord[/url] for feedback!

notes.title: Ongoing Multiplayer Patch
notes.notes: I changed around a few blueprints and added in Advanced Steam Sessions and Advanced Sessions.

notes.title: Minor Dungeon Adjustments
notes.notes: Decreased the amount of enemies in each dungeon due to change of combat style (action to tab-targeting). Also, messed around with the lighting a bit in the Village and Merchants Path maps.

notes.title: Updated Combat Anims
notes.notes:
With tab-targeting being the flow of combat, the combat anims needed to be slightly tweaked as well to fit with the cooldown for each character. There is still a very *slight* delay now but I will continue to smooth it out as I work on other areas of the game - such as Galgin Mines.

I won't be touching Tormin's Tomb for a while until the redesign is set in place, but I will remove the breakable objects from each map since that will no longer be a thing for me to worry about covering.

To note, or really just something I had in mind, is the change of atmosphere for the Village map and perhaps that of the Merchants Path map too. It could be the clouds or weather type or amount of daylight permitted. I'm unsure until I get a good feeling for it.

notes.title: Change of Combat (and more!)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

With this latest update, I've made the change from action combat to tab-targeting. Reason for this was primarily due to animation limitations and what I could do to fix/polish them. We'll see how this plays out but I'm confident that this is the way to go for the future of the game and later chapters. 

Also, I've included "Galgin Mines" map as well, but still is considered WIP. I'll throw in some music and background SFX whenever I get the chance, but my main focus is polishing the combat anims to sync properly with the skill cooldown associated with them. I can see this being fixed by next Sunday - along with a few other tweaks, but will keep everyone posted about that in the [url=https://discord.gg/YH5WNS6DPe]Discord[/url] server. 

So please, let me know in the Steam Discussions or on Discord of any feedback that you have. And yes, I know that multiplayer is still broken and will remain as high priority for the time being.

notes.title: Build 0.40 Update
notes.notes: [p]Heyas! It has been a while and I want to apologize for the (severe) lack of communication on my part, but the update had taken longer that I had hoped due to technical issues regarding the multiplayer feature - which is still either unstable or not working at all :D  [/p][p][/p][p]First off, let's talk about the multiplayer. It doesn't really work but the options are there to either Find or Host a session. The programmer and I are still in communication about what is happening and trying to fix it. I'll keep ya'll posted once it is fixed.  [/p][p][/p][p]Second, the weapons can now level up! That's right, now whenever you pick up, for example, an Iron Sword while you either have one equipped or there's already one in your inventory, that will level up. And by "level up" I mean the stats will slightly increase until the weapon (including shields) reaches level 10. Once it does reach max level, a new (fixed) stat will be added. I don't expect all the weapons to be perfect and totally not broken, but any feedback would be great!  [/p][p][/p][p]Credits! Yes! There is now a "Credits" option within the Main Menu screen. This will be updated regularly as I want to give credit to those I have either hired or using their assets through FAB (Epic's Marketplace). Always give credit where credit is due.  [/p][p][/p][p]Keys and Doors! Although I haven't had time to fully implement this - which I will be working on this weekend, certain doors (and chests!) will require one of the following key types: Bronze, Silver, and Gold. Bronze keys will open up passage ways that allow the player to normally progress through the game and some basic chests. Silver keys will open areas with monsters on a slightly more difficulty scale - but with better rewards! Last, the Gold keys open up both boss doors - be it dungeon progression or otherwise.  As for redesign of the first dungeon, that will happen and be implemented once things have been optimized and thoroughly checked.   [/p][p][/p][p]I wish I could say when the next update will be, but with being a dad/husband and working a full-time job, I haven't had the time I wish I did to get things going faster. Best way to do it for now is by hiring those who are more skilled than I to get it all done. I depend on the success of this game and the feedback as well. Speaking of which, the combat will be changed from your typical ARPG to more of tab-targeting, but that will occur once I have the budget for it.  [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all again for your support, and please make sure to join the [url="https://discord.gg/YH5WNS6DPe"]Discord server[/url]![/p]

notes.title: Tormin's Tomb Redesign
notes.notes:
Hello, hello!

It's been a busy month for me with my full-time job but I have been busy with the project on the side, and even had the pleasure of hiring a talented Level Designer to help with the redesign of both Tormin's Tomb and Harver Stronghold! I wasn't too happy with my own work on both of those dungeons, so having someone come in with more experience is what I needed to help with the vision I have.

You can find the screenshots within the Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/YH5WNS6DPe]here[/url], and go straight to "level-pictures" sub-channel :)

notes.title: Update Postponed
notes.notes:
Hello!

It certainly has been a while since I had last posted any news about updating the game, and there's a reason for that, too. Originally, I was going to release Galgin Mines this weekend but felt as though the level itself wasn't ready and the programmer and I have worked out a list of new features to be implemented by the end of May - such as a functioning multiplayer! There will be a few more worked on that will greatly change the gameplay itself and exploration. 

What I can say is this, the game isn't "dead" and nor will it ever be in the foreseeable future. This is a passion project of mine and will continuously work on it, even if it is in small chunks. With having a full-time job and being a husband/dad, I do have more important commitments to attend to. That being said, I try to put in the time into either the UE project or the GDD, and I hope that all of you will enjoy what will be brought into the game in the coming months :)

notes.title: TCCU News: New dungeon "Galgin Mines"
notes.notes:
With this new update, there will be a new dungeon and boss, as well as other things in the works to help tell the "Usurper" chapter within [b]The Chimera Chronicles[/b]. The dungeon itself won't be as elaborate as Boshta castle, but will certainly have plenty of monsters for you to fight and treasure to be found! 

As mentioned before in a previous post, I'm currently reworking the each character's active skill VFX and some balancing as well. This is top priority for me, for the time being concerning this update - that and the layout of Galgin Mines.

Speaking of Boshta castle, that will be my focus after this update, but we will see how things go and I might change up my plans a bit based on feedback.

Anyways, I'll have some screenshots of the new dungeon coming in soon and hope that ya'll get to enjoy the new horrors that await you :D

notes.title: TCCU Update 3/30/2025
notes.notes:
First, I want to apologize for the lateness of this update but there were some technical issues on my end with the computer.

The second dungeon is (somewhat) complete, as is the first and the soon-to-be third dungeon. Reason why is because of another update will introduce a key & door system, along with unique items and NPCs. As always, feedback helps me out a lot with the ongoing process of this game :)

The skill trees, for the most part, have been redesigned - save for Feos' and Mia's because I didn't see a reason to change their design. That being said, I did change around the amount of health, mana, and whatever other stats to be either lowered or raised based on testing.

I will have another announcement to make regarding the next update but that is scheduled for Friday evening (probably around 10pm~11pm JST). What I can say for now is that I really want to focus on redesigning the VFX for each character's [active] skill, along with any balancing needing to be done.

That's all for now and I hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Exploring Myria (Content Update Part 2)
notes.notes:
What I'm currently working on at the moment is the second dungeon for the Merchants Path map, but with higher level enemies, and the redesign of the skill tree for each character. ETA would most likely be March 30th - if all goes well. 

Just as a reminder, I will be on family vacation from the 16th to the 21st. Which means no project time but will have most of the second dungeon completed by then. It's really the skill tree redesigns that will take up a lot of my time. What I'm going for is something more simpler and straight-forward, making it more user-friendly. If I can throw in a background design for each one, then great. If not, then perhaps for the update after that ;)

If you wish to stay tuned to what is going on some more with the game, then feel free to join up in the [url=https://discord.gg/YH5WNS6DPe]Discord[/url] channel (which can be found in the Store Page of the game).

notes.title: Exploring Myria (Content Update Part 1)
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow adventurers!

This update comes with a beginner dungeon within a hefty world map, and two other dungeons that are currently non-accessible but are WIP. The randomize dungeon generator has been turned off due to balancing issues and that it was completely not functioning as a multiplayer feature. Speaking of which, multiplayer is currently being worked on along with a couple other features. 

Weapons no longer have random stats and will instead of set stats and level restrictions (this also goes for shields as well). The reason being is for balancing purposes and the upcoming weapon leveling system.

Breakable objects are a thing now! Well, kinda because the enemies will straight up run throw them without any notice. This will be fixed (someday).

There will be another update as a sort of "follow-up" and that will be more for the other two dungeons in the world map, along with enemy placement in said map, more NPCs, and bosses!

notes.title: Exploring Myria
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's been a (long) while since I had last made an announcement and that one felt a bit dreary. Well, My apologies on that. I've been in talks with a programmer to help reshape the "foundations" of my game - which includes multiplayer to get working. There are other changes that might occur, too, but that really depends if those are within my budget as well.

In the meantime, I had time to work on new dungeons, enemy hit reactions (which still needs tweaking), breakable objects, and a redesign on the weapons. I'll explain more on that once I have it all done, and the due date for this new update should be on February 28th, but anything can happen to push that date back a bit. I'll keep ya'll posted if anything changes.

Also, my personal work schedule will change just for the month of March and I have a week long family vacation starting from March 16th to the 21st. There are other work-related events going on that might hinder my time on the project, but regardless of those, I will stay focused on getting these changes and updates done.

notes.title: TCCU News: Crossroads
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone.

This isn't something that I was looking forward to typing out but I had already made this decision two days ago, and this is I'm going to hold off on this update that I had originally planned for 1/31/2025. It won't be indefinite and I will not take the game off of Steam either. Instead, I will leave it where it is right now and focus on hiring a (more) skilled programmer to help layout the foundation of the game utilizing the ARPG System Template and Dungeon Architect. The direction is will be more focused on a particular gameplay style that I love but never could have done on my own.

I know this is something similar to what a lot of indie devs would post and then never update the game again and move onto greener pastures, but that isn't what I have in mind. This game must be made and will be in due time, but to a standard that I would be proud of. As for the update that I had planned to release... there's already a dungeon that is 95% done (monsters, sfx, vfx, layout, etc) but even then, I wasn't happy with what was before me. It felt like a poor man's Dragon's Dogma and I didn't want any of it.

I will be updating everyone on the progress of the update once I find a programmer (be it Fiverr or elsewhere). You can find out on the Discord server and on X (Twitter). 

I do apologize for doing this but I feel that this is the best course of action to take. See ya'll when I do.

notes.title: TCCU News: Brave New World
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! First, I'd like to thank you for playing TCCU and joining the Discord server, as well. It really does mean a lot to me and I am always open to feedback on the game.

To start off on what has been happening since the last patch, I've been working on a new map for ya'll to explore but in small chunks. The landscape is 50% done and same goes for the first dungeon - where you  [i]should[/i] start grinding for new weapons and leveling, as the monsters in the portal will now start off at level 20! That's right, there will be a major overhaul on level progression and character skills/abilities.

I'm really looking forward to seeing where this goes and how to improve upon it, and if you'd like to help out or want to give feedback, please do so on here or in the Discord server. The reason [i]why[/i] I decided to go down this route is because as I had originally planned for TCC (the saga itself) is to slowly build upon the game with more content that is story driven and world building. Having ya'll stuck in a village with a dank portal and a nigh-empty castle wasn't doing me any favors - and it isn't like I will give up on either of those places! I have plans for them but require a bit more time and they're not as important right now than having the players actually explore the world that I'm building.

So yea, the big update should be up by the end of this month but anything IRL can hold that back until I find the time to work on it. What I want to say is that this big update won't be "huge" by any means but most certainly a step in the right direction for the game's development.

Again, thank you to everyone that has either played the game or has shown interest. I hope to see you around again soon :)

Hi, everyone!

First, I'd like to thank ya'll for playing TCCU and if you haven't already, see which of your favorite Curators have and check out their review.

Now, I know that there are [b][i]some[/i][/b] bugs that need to be fixed ASAP - such as the memory leak issue.
